summary: Every job now reports its runs, and a job that keeps failing recovers by itself.

new.title: Every job now shows its runs
new.text: Database setup, support access and configuration changes now appear under Jobs & runs, like every other job.

new.title: Failing jobs retry with smaller batches
new.text: A job whose last runs did not complete now works in smaller batches, halving each time. A size that keeps timing out is no longer retried unchanged.

new.title: New alerts to Invardia
new.text: Invardia is now alerted when a job misses three runs in a row or when records had to be skipped. Both alerts close by themselves.

fixes.title: Backups open on every system
fixes.text: A policy name with a character such as ':' or '?' no longer creates a backup file that Windows cannot open.

fixes.title: Identity report reads AD user ids correctly
fixes.text: The identity report now reads the security identifier of on-premises AD users correctly.
